params.prompt: A frame grabbed from a Korean sitcom video, 9:16 vertical: candid mid-action, caught between movements, slight natural motion softness, not a posed photo. Evening living room (warm lamps, string lights, arched window dark navy), fixed tripod camera at eye level, natural skin, no beauty filter, no text, no watermark. Reference images: first the exact FACE(s) to keep (identity must match exactly), then the outfit sheet(s), then the room. People: the man (29, Korean, round gold wire glasses, jet-black two-block hair, navy overshirt open over a white T-shirt, company ID badge on a navy lanyard, grey trousers). Situation: 소파를 돌아 아일랜드로 세 걸음. Emotion: 조급, 촐싹. Action: 걷는 중, 한 발 든 채, 폰 앞으로. Show the action clearly in one frame; the face stays the reference face.
